text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Dear Mom and Dad, Before the race, I was more nervous than a long-tailed cat in a room full of rocking chairs.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I was worried I wouldn't be able to pull off a cool performance, or about what'd happen if I lost again and my fans still didn't care…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Sure, I had heaps of fans at the paddock, but I don't think any of them were too excited about seeing me run…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: But then I remembered that my trainer (and you two!) believe in me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: That's when I made up my mind! I decided I was gonna make my hard work pay off, no matter what!
